summary_en: Japan Creative Platform Group will acquire all remaining shares of Japan Broadcast Solutions Co., Ltd. through a simplified stock exchange, exchanging 137,970 treasury shares (146 shares per 1 JBS share) to make JBS a wholly-owned subsidiary. The transaction is scheduled to close on December 1, 2026, and does not require shareholder approval for the parent company.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Subsidiary Status of Japan Broadcast Solutions Co., Ltd. through Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief:
Japan Creative Platform Group Co., Ltd. announced on October 8, 2026, that it will acquire all remaining shares of Japan Broadcast Solutions Co., Ltd. (JBS) through a simplified stock exchange, making JBS a wholly-owned subsidiary. The exchange ratio is fixed at 146 shares of Japan Creative Platform for each share of JBS. The parent company will transfer 137,970 treasury shares held in its own account to effect the exchange, with no new shares to be issued.

The transaction is scheduled to take effect on December 1, 2026. JBS shareholders will vote on the stock exchange at a special general shareholders meeting to be held on November 25, 2026. Japan Creative Platform will not require shareholder approval, as the transaction qualifies as a simplified stock exchange under Article 796, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act. The exchange ratio was derived using market price valuation for Japan Creative Platform (based on three-month, six-month, and one-year average closing prices as of September 25, 2026) and adjusted book value net asset method for JBS. An independent third-party valuer (FYD) calculated an exchange ratio range of 131.77 to 174.28, and the agreed ratio of 146 falls within that range.

Japan Creative Platform has held 81.10% of JBS since October 2022, when JBS became a consolidated subsidiary following business cooperation that began in April 2021. Both companies are in the creative services sector: Japan Creative Platform handles advertising, design data processing, and multi-material printing and content creation; JBS provides engineering services for audio-visual systems, broadcasting facilities, and related support across facilities, schools, and broadcast stations. Management expects the transaction will accelerate decision-making and improve resource allocation, enabling more agile and efficient service delivery.
